# RAINCLOUD

> RAINCLOUD is GTM diagnosis and repair for B2B companies between $50M and $200M. Colin Dowling scores the motion, rebuilds it in 90 days on a fee that steps down, then stays on as the team runs it.

RAINCLOUD is run by Colin Dowling: 3x VP of Sales · 2x founder · Host, Modern Business Life. VP Global Enterprise Sales at GoDaddy, SVP Revenue at Alembic (Seed to $145M Series B), VP Channel Sales at Liquid Web, Enterprise Sales Director at WP Engine. Colin runs every engagement personally. There is no delivery team, no junior analyst, and no offshore bench. Two builds at a time, with a small number of advisory clients alongside them.

## The offer ladder

1. The 20 Minute Teardown. Free. It covers roughly 40 of the 100-Point GTM Autopsy's 100 points: the ones that can be scored from outside the company, from public sources alone. No mystery shop. Book it at https://rncld.com/15minutepipelineteardown/ or https://calendly.com/30minutechat/20-minute-go-to-market-w-colin
2. The 100-Point GTM Autopsy. $5,000, 10 business days. All 100 points across ten sections, each scored met or not met (one point each, 100 total), against the client's CRM data and four to six interviews; a signed baseline; every finding, ranked by what it costs in pipeline, each quantified; the fix sequence; a one-page business case; a 45-minute readout. Required before any engagement. Credited in full toward any engagement. No-questions-asked money-back guarantee.
3. The 90-Day GTM Fix. $37,500, billed $15,000 (month 1, diagnose and rebuild), $12,500 (month 2, install), $10,000 (month 3, prove and hand off). The outbound architecture installed in month 2 uses four components: Hunter, Harvester, Farmer and Shepherd.
4. Ongoing. Advisory at $7,500 per month from month four (monthly operating review, monthly work session, weekly office hours, quarterly re-score of all 100 points). Or the GTM Scorecard at $4,000 per month, billed quarterly: measurement and direction only, available from month seven or directly after a 100-Point GTM Autopsy.

The 100-Point GTM Framework is free. It is the full scoring list, not a separate paid step. Reading the list is free. The score is the 100-Point GTM Autopsy.

Terms: six-month minimum from engagement start (three months of build, three of advisory), cancel any time after. The 100-Point GTM Autopsy is credited in full toward any engagement and covered by a no-questions-asked money-back guarantee. Nothing is sold before it.

## Who it is for

B2B companies between $50M and $200M in revenue, with a sales team that works out of a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or comparable), selling through outbound or inbound email and phone conversations, missing a number they have already committed to, with one executive who will own the work for six months. Below the range is sometimes a fit; above it there is usually an internal team.

## Results

- AgentPress: 7 to 25 qualified meetings a month in 45 days.
- 1905 New Media: digital services from $4M to $11M over two years.

- [Founder-led sales trap](https://rncld.com/problems/founder-led-sales-trap/): It works, which is the problem. It relieves the pressure that would otherwise have forced the system to mature, and it signals to the team that the system is optional. Next step: the 90-day engagement.
- [Pipeline not growing](https://rncld.com/problems/pipeline-not-growing/): Stage definitions that mean different things to different reps. Coverage math built on deals that are already dead. Next step: the 20 Minute Teardown, then the 100-Point GTM Autopsy.

## What RAINCLOUD is not

Not a SaaS product, not a dashboard or seat-based software vendor, not an agency, and not an open-ended hourly engagement. Earlier versions of this site described a "4D Sales Intelligence" offering, a "Trident" architecture, and separate offers for demand generation, content, AI readiness and AI agents. All are retired here. RAINCLOUD sells GTM diagnosis and repair: a free 20 Minute Teardown, a 100-Point GTM Autopsy, a 90-day rebuild on a declining fee, and ongoing advisory. Colin's other ventures are separate sites: Ants (managed AI agents, withants.com), Ghostwriter (B2B content, friendlyghostwriter.com) and The AI Ready Advisor (executive AI strategy).
